AI model library

Prices · context windows · modalities · features — one profile per model

This library records API profiles of major LLMs (including internationally priced models in USD): vendor, context window, supported modalities, input/output/cache-hit prices and verification dates, each with a clickable source link. Open a card for the full model profile, estimate a monthly cost in the cost calculator, or compare two models line by line in the model comparison. All prices are official published list prices in the vendor's original billing currency (some models are tiered by input length as noted); the vendor's console prevails.

Price sorting converts each model's estimated monthly cost at default usage (same basis as the cost calculator) to CNY (1 USD = 6.718 CNY, CFETS central parity rate 2026-10-23, indicative only); models with unverified rates are excluded from price sorting.
